dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent O-shaped rings exhibit irregular, crenulated perimeters with a sharp high-contrast transition from the dark dorsal fur to the light-colored rings, which then transition back to a darker, speckled interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, irregular high-intensity (light) pixel clusters scattered throughout the mid-dorsal region, primarily acting as satellites to or components of larger ring structures without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A group of four large annuli in the mid-lateral region forms an elongated irregular quadrilateral, with a series of smaller rings and blobs forming a secondary scalene triangle cluster superior to the hind flippers.
